notes:
I wasn't able to write any notes. The research tools stopped working before I could read a single page.

I set up fetches for six sources: Enduring Word, Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on biblehub.com, Precept Austin's Song of Solomon page, and the NET Bible notes. The first attempt broke because of a bug in my own code. My second attempt was refused because the session had run out of tool calls. So I have no page text for Song of Solomon 3 from any of the approved sites.

You asked me to report only what the pages say and not fill gaps from my own knowledge. With nothing read, any verse notes I wrote would be made up, so there are none here.

If you start a new request, I'll fetch those six pages first. After that I'll go to the tradition-specific sites for the verses where readings split. The likely ones are vv. 1–4 (the night search), v. 5 (the charge to the daughters of Jerusalem) and vv. 6–11 (Solomon's carriage and wedding). The sites would be monergism.com and ligonier.org for Reformed, gty.org and spurgeon.org for Baptist, wesley.nnu.edu for Methodist, enduringword.com for Pentecostal, lcms.org and 1517.org for Lutheran, and newadvent.org for Catholic. The notes would then be written verse by verse, with a URL after every point.
